title: Ghost on the Grand Staircase
description: A woman in a silver satin gown stands on a decaying spiral staircase, holding a glowing lantern while reaching toward a translucent ghostly figure of a man floating above her. The once-opulent mansion interior is peeling and ruined, with film reels scattered across the waterlogged floor below.
prompt: A woman in a flowing silver satin evening gown stands on a crumbling spiral staircase inside a decaying purple and gold mansion, holding a glowing lantern in one hand while reaching out with the other toward a translucent ghostly man in a suit floating in a beam of light. Peeling walls, scattered film reels and broken film strips floating in water at the bottom of the stairs, dramatic cinematic lighting, moody and surreal atmosphere
